No Crawl-delay is declared; probe.py's 2s per-host gap was applied anyway. TREE: taken from two independent sources and reconciled. (1) The server-rendered mega-menu in the homepage HTML (div.custom-dropdown-menu, 9 menus) - its own section headers are SEATING / RECLINING / LEATHER / TABLES & CABINETS (Living), DINING FURNITURE, BEDROOM FURNITURE + Bedding, OFFICE FURNITURE, DECOR + LIGHTING + SHOP BY STYLE (Home Decor), OUTDOOR FURNITURE, GET INSPIRED. There is no Bath, Bathroom, Vanity, Sanitaryware, Basin, Shower or Tap entry at any level of the mega-menu. (2) sitemap_index.xml -> sitemap_0.xml, 2,657 locs, of which 431 are non-PDP. Every one of those 431 URLs was listed and grepped for bath|bathroom|vanity|sink|basin|toilet|shower|tap|faucet|towel|sanitary|lavatory: the ONLY structural hits are /home-decor/mirrors and the blog article /blog/decorate-with-mirrors.html. Bassett's real departments are Living, Dining, Bedroom, Office, Outdoor, Home Decor, Rugs, Workroom, Inspiration and Sale - it is a case-goods / upholstery maker with no plumbing, sanitaryware or bath line at all. CONFIRMATION OF ABSENCE (three independent checks): (a) the site's own search returns 'Search Results (0)' for q=bathroom and 'Search Results (0)' for q=towel; (b) q=vanity returns 'Search Results (34)' but every hit is a bedroom dresser or accent chest (Andora 6 Drawer Dresser, Copenhagen 5 Drawer Chest, Heritage Bureau, Tidewater Dresser, Parkway Dresser ...) - the word matches marketing copy about using a dresser as a vanity, not a bathroom vanity unit, so rule 29 disambiguation sends it to Bedroom, not Bathroom; (c) the mirror department itself was opened and fully enumerated (see review). QTY: the one number recorded (53, in review) is the storefront's own rendered listing header .result-count on /home-decor/mirrors ('See Results (53) View All Results'), and it was corroborated by re-fetching the same node at ?start=0&sz=200 and counting unique data-pid tiles / distinct product titles in div.product-grid, which gave 53 distinct titles (54 data-pid nodes, one duplicated by the quickview markup). No count was estimated and none was aggregated. EXCLUDED: /home-decor/wall-decor and /home-decor/wall-decor/wall-art (wall art, rule 21 -> Wall Decor); /home-decor/cabinet-hardware + /knobs + /pulls and /bedroom/knobs-and-pulls and /dining/knobs-and-pulls (these are furniture cabinet knobs and pulls, not bathroom hardware - no bathroom parent, rule 17 needs a bathroom hierarchy); /home-decor/lighting, /floor-lamps, /table-lamps, /pendants-and-chandeliers, /bedroom/lighting, /dining/lighting, /office/lighting (general room lighting, none of it bathroom or vanity lighting, so nothing to route under rule 19); /bedroom/bedding/* and /home-decor/throws (bedding textiles, not bath linen - Bassett sells no towels, robes, shower curtains or bath mats, confirmed by the zero-result towel search); /bedroom/dressers-and-chests/* (bedroom case goods). CONCLUSION: confirmed absence, not a block - every page requested returned HTTP 200 and rendered its real grid. Status NO BATHROOM FOUND with rows = [] per rule 36; no fabricated rows.
